messages:
nina: kicking off IAD3 preflight — tagging infra-owners. goal: green for handoff by EOD tomorrow. quick sanity checklist below.

raj: thanks. can you paste the exact smoke commands? i want to run them against the canary pool.

nina: sure — small list here: 
```
# node health
ssh core@iad3-proxy-01 'systemctl status redwood-inference'
# GPU smoke infer (short seq)
curl -sS -X POST https://iad3-infer.internal/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rw-v1-small","input":"hello"}' | jq .status
# KV cache replay check
python tools/check_kv_cache.py --region iad3 --sample 100
```

sam: ran node health on proxy and got one warning on proxy-03: disk /var/log at 92%. wondering if we should rotate logs before full test.

lia: good catch. i'll rotate and restart journalctl on proxy-03 now. should be quick.

ops-bot: log-rotation job queued by lia. ETA ~40s.

maria: note on capacity: the initial reserved commit is 8xA100s for iad3, but we only have 6 live right now because of one failed node in rack-7 and one node in pending provisioning. that will impact SLA for 99th p50 under sustained bursts. planning a hotfix is fine but will change cost forecast.

raj: ok flagged. for smoke we can reduce batch to 1 and seq len 64 to avoid capacity blowouts. add to the test script.

nina: updated smoke script to small payloads. also added network egress verify: `iperf3 -c egress-check.internal -t 5` and cross-region replication dry-run: `kubectl -n infra exec deploy/replicator -- /app/repl-check --target=fra1`

sam: smoke infer returns status ok, latency 45ms on rw-v1-small canary (single token). KV cache replay shows 0.1% mismatch on sample 100 -> investigating.

lia: rotation done, proxy-03 disk now 38%. restarted service and it came back clean.

maria: about SLO gates — we should require: p95 < 200ms for small model, error rate < 0.5%, and cross-region replication latency < 2s for metadata. if any gate fails, handoff is paused. agree?

raj: agree. adding a cost note: if we enable burst capacity for peak tests, estimate +22% monthly on that pool. want signoff before enabling.

nina: noted. ops-runbook step: if any failed gateway/net error, engage eng-oncall and run `./scripts/net-collect --region iad3 --since 10m` then attach to ticket.

deploy-bot: canary deploy v2026.03.18 started for iad3 (deploy id: dpl-8342).

sam: canary deploy succeeded on 3/3 replicas. kernel messages show one GPU driver OOM on node gpu-07 earlier but pod recovered. tagging infra-ticket #4529.

lia: OOM might be from old driver version. gpu-07 is on 520.61, fleet target is 525.x. will schedule a driver patch during maintenance window.

maria: for the readiness review doc i added a quick cost delta and SLA note in the handoff doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/iad3-handoff — please review before review meeting.

nina: schedule readiness review at 1500 UTC tomorrow. ops, eng-ml, product-ops invited. if all gates green then we do formal handoff.

raj: prepping the acceptance checklist: attaching the final smoke log to the ticket once KV mismatch root cause confirmed.

sam: KV mismatch was due to stale prefix cache on replicate agent — fixed and re-run shows 0 mismatches. attaching fix and smoke output.

nina: awesome. current status: all smoke tests green, one infra ticket (driver patch) scheduled, capacity short by 2 GPUs pending procurement. SLO gate: PASS for small-model p95 and error rate. cross-region replication PASS.

maria: thanks team. i'll present cost delta and the driver patch timeline in the review.

nina: closing here — will post final handoff link after 1500 UTC review. :thumbsup:
